name: Nominee-account disruption and partial proceeds recovery

attribution.legal_posture: The Republic of Korea Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on 2023-03-09 that ROK-U.S. cooperation with the private sector had disabled a substantial portion of nominee accounts used by DPRK IT workers and recovered part of the proceeds. The statement is aggregate and covers disabled accounts and recovered proceeds; selectors, amounts, identities, platforms, affected organizations, and case-level outcomes remain outside its disclosure.

caveats: This source creates context only; account, person, platform, and employer records require separate evidence.
Account selectors, identities and recovery amounts remain limited to what the source discloses.
The source leaves open how many accounts were disabled, which platforms held them, how much money was recovered, and which authority performed each action.
This aggregate statement covers only aggregate context; account selectors, recovered amounts, beneficiary identities, platforms, and affected organizations require separate records.
An account held in another person's name requires independent evidence before it can be treated as DPRK-linked; this statement is aggregate.
This is aggregate enforcement context; account, person, company, and incident records require separate evidence.

infrastructure.statement: The ROK and United States assessed that close cooperation with the private sector had disabled a substantial portion of nominee accounts used by DPRK IT workers and recovered part of their illicit proceeds, constraining the activity.
infrastructure.original_language_title: 북한 IT 인력의 차명계정 차단 및 불법 수익 일부 회수
infrastructure.original_language_statement: 한미 양측이 민간 분야와 긴밀히 협력하여 북한 IT 인력의 차명계정을 상당 부분 차단하고 이들의 불법 수익 자금 역시 일부 회수함으로써 관련 활동을 위축시키는 성과를 거두었음을 평가하였다.
infrastructure.translation_note: English wording is a researcher translation retained alongside the original-language text.
